title: Dented white van seen at the facility and followed
place_text: Maryland, near the training facility and the Holiday Inn

tellings.quote: it. I looked at the white band that I saw at the exit and sure enough it had that same exact uh dent.

plain: A former sergeant named Dan Sherman, who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, says that during his time in Maryland between 1990 and 1993 he saw a white van with a dent at the exit of the facility where he trained, and later realised the same van was following him near his Holiday Inn. He tells Michels he checked the van and "sure enough it had that same exact uh dent." To him it meant he was being watched by people connected to the programme.
